reason: The glazing subcontractor is responsible for damage until handover, not me, so I have no budget line for this. At about 19 euro per m2 on top of what the glazier already does, it is a new supplier and a new cost for a problem I don't carry.
objection: Glass damage before handover is the glazier's cost, not ours. I would be paying to protect someone else's risk, and my owner will not add a supplier for that.
instead: Keep using cheap protection film and tape on the worst frames, and leave it to the glazing subcontractor to protect their own work.
would_change_my_mind: If the glazing subcontractor paid for it, or if I had a callback or snagging claim on a premium block that this clearly would have avoided.
